reviews.title: Arrived as if brand new
reviews.comment: Product arrived in original packaging as if brand new, DAC was in the box as well as the 2 sets of ear pads and all necessary cords. I had trouble with the microphone at first BUT .. I had not realized that the headphone jack was not plugged in all the way into the USB DAC. It takes a bit of force to put it in and there are 2 little clicks you'll hear when its all the way plugged in. I am assuming that a lot of people saying the microphone didn't work faced this issue and didn't bother to troubleshoot or the logitech microphone wasnt set as their default microphone or something. Anyways, headphones are great, seemed as if brand new, work wonderfully, mic is awesome, sound quality is awesome, definitely worth buying "used" and a sweet little upgrade. P.S. For the headphone sound I recommend going into the G Hub software and going into the presets on the headphones on the bottom left. From there you can go to "browse more presets" and download someone else's EQ settings. I recommend changing the tab from most recent to most downloaded. I found the " PRO X/PRO GAMING CONFIG "  Sounds great.
reviews.author: Andrew

reviews.title: Great Gaming Headphones
reviews.comment: I ordered a refurbished pair from seller "GBGOODIES LLC". The headphones look brand new, and came with all cables, the USB DAC, and even an extra pair of ear cups. These headphones are built very sturdy, as denoted by the thick aluminum frame. They sound great, as does the mic (I've listened to my own game recordings.) However, I found that in some games like Warzone (the first one, not 2.0) they were VERY bassy. You can use the equalizer in the Logitech G Hub software, which works fine. I decided to use the HeSuVi program w/ the DHT setting to model the 7.1 surround sound instead. I find it very accurate in games like Warzone as well as Rainbow Six Siege. This is actually my second pair of these. I paid full retail of $130 for my first set at Best Buy, and I paid less than half of that for this refurb pair to use on my work PC.
reviews.author: Max

reviews.title: Great Product with good price
reviews.comment: I recently bought this headset to play PC games like League of Legends. So far I really satisfied with the headphone. First, it arrives on time. The package is good and there are no damages. The sound quality is also great. It can deliver clear sounds so that I can enjoy my games. It is very comfortable to use it for a long time because of the cushioned ear cups.
reviews.author: Jihyun H.

reviews.title: Great headset but heavy!
reviews.comment: The fit is perfect for me and I do like the weight. Sounds are crystal clear and the mic transmits clearly. That's are not as loud as others that I have owned, but I suppose that's good in the long run. I use these for gaming and listening to music. Hight recommended.
